title: fix(scripts): the vite resolve oracle stops writing its scratch root into the swept repo root (objectui#9468)
body:
Fixes #9468

## The race, reproduced before it was repaired

`viteResolves()` in `scripts/__tests__/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` made its throwaway Vite build root with `mkdtempSync` **directly in the repo root** and removed it again seconds later. `textFootprint()` in `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` sweeps that same repo root with a single `grep -rFn` pass. In the same shard, grep enumerates the scratch directory, fails to descend into it, and exits **2** — and `textFootprint()`'s catch rethrows every status but 1 deliberately, its comment saying why. The shard dies with ~10,500 passing tests in it.

Driving the **real** `textFootprint()` over the **real** repo root, three legs:

| leg | scratch dir | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| control | none present | `rounds 3, ok 3, status2 0` |
| **failing** | `.vite-oracle-9408-*` in the repo root | **`rounds 3, ok 0, status2 3`** |
| after the fix | `.vite-oracle-9408-*` under `node_modules/` | `rounds 3, ok 3, status2 0` |
| **failing** | `.tmp-citation-gate-*` in the repo root | **`rounds 3, ok 0, status2 3`** |
| after the fix | `.tmp-citation-gate-*` under `node_modules/` | `rounds 3, ok 3, status2 0` |

The failing leg reproduces the CI message character for character but for the random suffix:

```
grep: /home/user/objectui-issue-9468/.vite-oracle-9408-tzczpE: No such file or directory
Serialized Error: { status: 2, … }
```

## Why the scratch root moved to `node_modules/` rather than to `os.tmpdir()`

The card offered two shapes. Both were measured; **neither is the one that landed**, and the reason is a constraint the producer already documented.

**`os.tmpdir()` breaks the oracle.** The docstring on `viteResolves()` states that the root lives inside the repository because bare-specifier resolution walks up from the importer looking for `node_modules`, and from `/tmp` there is none. Measured, not inherited — moving it to `os.tmpdir()` and running the suite:

```
AssertionError: Vite oracle resolved nothing — broken instrument: expected null to be truthy
 Test Files  1 failed (1)   Tests  1 failed | 39 passed (40)
```

The suite's own anti-vacuity control catches it, which is the good case; the bad case is that this is the exact failure direction that reads as a clean pass.

**Adding `.vite-oracle-*` to the sweep's skip set fixes one scanner and leaves the class alive.** That set is a whitelist, and objectui#9201 already answered this same class that way once — this card is its recurrence.

`repoRoot/node_modules` is the placement that satisfies both constraints at once: still inside the repository, so the walk-up finds a `node_modules`; and inside a directory every repo-wide scanner under `scripts/` already skips, so nothing transient placed there is walked by any of them. `scripts/__tests__/check-action-ref-convention.test.ts` already puts its throwaway root in the same place.

The suite stays green at the new placement: `Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 40 passed (40)`.

## Two pins, each shown to fail

Both ablations mutated the tree on disk, proved the mutation landed before reading any result, and restored from `HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards.

| pin | ablation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the oracle's scratch root is never a repo-root entry | put the placement back in the repo root | red: `expected '.vite-oracle-9408-fq9i4U' to be 'node_modules'` |
| the sweep never descends into `node_modules` | drop `node_modules` from `TEXT_SWEEP_SKIP_DIRS` | red: `expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'packages/x/src/Reader.tsx' ]` |

The second ablation earned its keep. The first draft of that pin spelled its fixture `node_modules/some-dep/dist/index.js`, and `dist` is in the skip set too — so the ablation left the pin **green**, pinning nothing. The fixture path now carries exactly one excluded segment, and the test comment records why.

## Verification

| check | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `vitest run --project unit` on the two deciding suites | `Test Files 2 passed (2)` / `Tests 175 passed (175)` |
| `vitest run --project unit` on the citation gate's suite | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 34 passed (34)` |
| `vitest run --project unit scripts/__tests__/` | `Test Files 169 passed \| 2 skipped (171) · Tests 4870 passed \| 2 skipped (4872)` |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | exit 0; `tsc --listFiles` confirms all three changed files are in the program |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | `OK (scanned 7785 tracked text file(s))` |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | `OK` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `0 new citation(s) -> exit 0` |
| `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |

ESLint over the three changed files: exit 0, **0 errors**. The citation gate's file reports 0 warnings; the oracle's file carries 5 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all at lines outside every hunk this branch adds (warnings at 117/935/960/1112/1146, hunks at 142-177/188-189/193/220-235), so all pre-existing. This is a narrowed run, not the repo-wide one: the repo-wide lint is CI's, and the config carries no type-aware linting, so a change inside these three files cannot move the verdict on a file the branch does not touch.

All figures above were measured at `73dfdda84`, the branch head this PR carries.

## Acceptance notes

This branch repairs **both** repo-root scratch directories, so the claim is *"removes the class as it exists in this tree"* rather than *"removes one instance"*.

`scripts/__tests__/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.test.ts` built the throwaway git repo for its `exits 0 on findings under report-only and 1 under --strict` test the same way, with `mkdtempSync` straight into the repo root. It is not a theoretical twin — the same reproduction against that prefix fails identically:

```
rounds 3, ok 0, status2 3
grep: …/.tmp-citation-gate-pF6w0r: No such file or directory
```

The same one-line move repairs it, and the suite is unchanged at the new placement: `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 34 passed (34)` — including the `git init` that scratch repo performs, which creates its own repository wherever it is put.

⚠ That producer gets **no positional pin of its own**. The thing that would pin every producer at once is a gate refusing repo-root scratch state, and that is a new verification surface — a decision, not this card's repair. It stays recorded on objectui#9468 for its own card.

Noted, not filed — neither `.vite-oracle-*` nor `.tmp-citation-gate-*` is in `.gitignore` (only `.objectui-tmp` is). That is now moot for these two, since `node_modules` is ignored, but it stays recorded as the same decision the gate above would be: what the tree owes is a rule about where scratch state may live, not two more ignore entries. Carrier: the class card.
